items.title: Middle East / Strait of Hormuz
items.detail: Renewed US-Iran strikes kept a geopolitical bid under oil; Brent whipsawed ~$73-79 intraweek. De-escalation lowered it Jul 9 but supply risk remains live.

items.title: AI-leadership concentration
items.detail: Index gains still driven by a narrow set of semis/AI names (SMH +2.5% carried the tape). A single guide-down from NVDA/MU/AVGO could reprice the complex.

items.title: Rates / possible Fed hike
items.detail: 10Y 4.56%, futures price ~64% odds of a hike by year-end with fed funds 3.63%. A hawkish surprise pressures long-duration/high-multiple software.

items.title: Valuation / thin risk premium
items.detail: S&P ~8.7% above its 200DMA with VIX 16.9 — complacency leaves little cushion for a shock.

items.title: Energy-price pass-through
items.detail: Any re-spike in Brent would lift headline inflation and complicate the Fed path, a headwind for consumer and rate-sensitive sectors.

items.title: Curve positive but flat
items.detail: 10Y-2Y only ~+0.41pp; not inverted, but a flat curve limits margin tailwinds for banks if cuts return.
